_comment: The hand-written Training tree of every school: one tree per school, rooted in its basic skills (tier 0, no requirements) and climbing to its capstones (tier 5). Every skill of a school is in its tree. Each node names the node(s) it grows out of; a node with two requires wants both. The tier is the one source of a skill's numbers: MP [8,16,26,40,58,80] or AP [8,14,22,34,50,70] (x1.35 all-target, x1.1 random-target, x0.85 self, +10% per rider, +10% per extra hit, scaled by damage weight, x0.75 when MP is paid too, capped at 100), damage coefficient [4.5,5.7,7.2,9,11.2,14] against the plain attack's 3 (x0.65 all-target, x0.85 with a rider, x0.8 drain), heal [15,22,30,40,52,70]% of max HP (x0.6 party-wide), StatReq [4,7,10,13,16,19], and KP [60,120,220,380,600,900] (x2 Esoteric, x10 Forbidden) in SkillMaster.js. Read as window.Skills.SkillTrees by SkillGraph in js/plugins/CharacterCreation/SkillMaster.js.
